name: @letta-ai/muscle-memory
description: A Letta Code mod that lets an agent watch itself work and write its own reusable skills. It runs the full Complementary-Learning-Systems loop (capture -> prediction-error-gated consolidation -> graduate) over its real tool-use, recovers failures the harness silently drops, and compounds: updating a learned skill strengthens its proven core instead of clobbering it.
author: Adrian Chan
